text: しめつけや　まきつきや　やどりぎのタネや　まきびし　などの　れんぞくの　わざから　ぬけだせる。

structure.jp: しめつけや　まきつきや　やどりぎのタネや　まきびし　などの
structure.en: such as binding, wrapping, Leech Seed and Spikes

structure.jp: れんぞくの　わざから

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to the e-sound plus る says 'can do'. ぬけだす 'break free' becomes ぬけだせる = 'can break free'.

patterns.name: 〜などの
patterns.explanation: などの after a list says 'things such as these' and ties the list to the next word. まきびし　などの　れんぞくの　わざ = 'continuous moves such as Spikes'.
